_help: Birthday message wording. {name} = preferred name, {sender} = your name from config.json. Each option has a label (shown in the Wording menu on each card) and the text. "for": "senior" marks the version picked automatically for clients turning 65 or more. Add, edit or remove options freely. Keep messages warm and personal, with no product or sales content.

today.label: Warm thank-you
today.text:
Happy Birthday, {name}! 🎂 Wishing you good health, happiness and a wonderful year ahead. Thank you for your trust all these years - it's always a privilege to be part of your journey. Have a lovely celebration with your loved ones!

- {sender}
